name: Deno Generic
author: krevan76@users.noreply.github.com
description: A generic egg to run Deno applications.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    echo -e "no git repo set, upload your files and start the server"
    exit 0
fi

if [ "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ] && [ -d .git ]; then
    git pull
elif [ -z "${BRANCH}" ]; then
    git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
else
    git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
fi

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch to clone, blank for the repo default branch

variables.name: Main File
variables.description: The file to run with deno
